list.name: log_group
list.label: 로그 그룹
list.description: Nginx 액세스 로그가 저장된 CloudWatch 로그 그룹 이름

list.name: geo_log_group
list.label: GeoIP 로그 그룹
list.description: Lambda가 GeoIP 필드를 추가해 기록하는 로그 그룹

panels.title: GeoIP 수집률

targets.expression:
fields (ispresent(country_code) and country_code != "") as has_geo
| stats sum(has_geo) * 100 / count(*) as geo_coverage

panels.description: 보강 로그 중 국가가 조회된 비율. 사설 IP(내부망, 헬스체크)는 국가가 없으므로 100% 미만일 수 있습니다.

targets.expression:
filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| stats count_distinct(country_code) as countries

filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| fields country_code != "KR" as foreign
| stats sum(foreign) * 100 / count(*) as foreign_ratio

filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| filter country_code != "KR" and request_uri like /(?i)(union.*select|%27|<script|%3Cscript|\.\.\/|%2e%2e|onerror=)/
| stats count(*) as foreign_attacks

panels.title: 국가별 접속 히트맵

targets.expression:
filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| stats count(*) as cnt, count_distinct(ip) as unique_ips by country_code, country_name

panels.description: 국가 코드(ISO 2자리)로 국가 중심 좌표에 매핑합니다. 레이어 목록에서 히트맵/마커를 켜고 끌 수 있습니다.

targets.expression:
filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| stats count(*) as cnt by country_name
| sort cnt desc
| limit 10

panels.title: 도시 단위 접속 히트맵

targets.expression:
filter ispresent(lat) and ispresent(lon)
| stats count(*) as cnt by lat, lon, city, country_code

panels.description: GeoIP 위도/경도 기준. IP 위치는 도시 수준의 근사치입니다.

panels.title: 공격 의심 요청 출발지

targets.expression:
filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| filter request_uri like /(?i)(union.*select|%27|<script|%3Cscript|\.\.\/|%2e%2e|onerror=)/
| stats count(*) as cnt, count_distinct(ip) as attackers by country_code, country_name

panels.description: 보안 탐지(06)와 같은 패턴으로 걸러낸 요청의 국가 분포입니다.

targets.expression:
filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| stats count(*) as cnt by bin(5m), country_code

filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| fields (status >= 400) as is_err
| stats sum(is_err) * 100 / count(*) as error_rate by bin(5m), country_code

filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| fields (status >= 400) as is_err, request_uri like /(?i)(union.*select|%27|<script|%3Cscript|\.\.\/|%2e%2e|onerror=)/ as is_attack
| stats count(*) as requests, count_distinct(ip) as unique_ips, sum(is_err) as errors, sum(is_attack) as attacks, latest(@timestamp) as last_seen by country_code, country_name
| sort requests desc

filter ispresent(country_code) and country_code != ""
| stats count(*) as requests, count_distinct(path) as paths by country_code, city, ip
| sort requests desc
| limit 20
